description:
We are Halley's Comet, a passionate and multidisciplinary team of innovators who participated in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, working on the challenge Flame in Freefall: SI-Powered Fire Safety Insights from Microgravity Combustion Data.

Our team is driven by curiosity, creativity, scientific exploration, and a shared passion for using technology and space science to solve real-world problems. We are particularly interested in space exploration, artificial intelligence, data science, engineer
